q01:
WITH orders_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.ordered_at,
        ol.product_id,
        ol.qty,
        ol.amount_cents,
        r.amount_cents AS refund_amount_cents
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_lines ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    LEFT JOIN refunds r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND o.ordered_at BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-08-01'
), net_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        c.region_id,
        SUM(ol.amount_cents - COALESCE(r.refund_amount_cents, 0)) AS revenue_cents
    FROM orders_filtered ol
    JOIN customers c ON ol.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN refunds r ON ol.order_id = r.order_id
    GROUP BY c.region_id
)
SELECT
    r.name AS region,
    SUM(nr.revenue_cents) AS revenue_cents
FROM net_revenue nr
JOIN regions r ON nr.region_id = r.region_id
GROUP BY r.name
HAVING SUM(nr.revenue_cents) > 0
q02:
WITH revenue_data AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        SUM(ol.amount_cents) AS order_total,
        SUM(r.amount_cents) AS refunds_total
    FROM 
        order_lines ol
    LEFT JOIN 
        refunds r ON ol.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE 
        ol.order_id IN (
            SELECT 
                o.order_id 
            FROM 
                orders o 
            WHERE 
                o.status <> 'cancelled' 
                AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
                AND o.ordered_at BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-08-01'
        )
    GROUP BY 
        ol.order_id
)
SELECT 
    SUM(order_total - COALESCE(refunds_total, 0)) AS revenue_cents
FROM 
    revenue_data

    LEFT JOIN

filtered_orders AS (

q05:
WITH revenue_data AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        SUM(ol.qty * ol.amount_cents) AS revenue_cents,
        SUM(r.amount_cents) AS refund_cents
    FROM
        orders od
    JOIN
        order_lines ol ON od.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN
        products p ON ol.product_id = p.product_id
    LEFT JOIN
        refunds r ON od.order_id = r.order_id
    JOIN
        customers c ON od.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN
        regions rgn ON c.region_id = rgn.region_id
    WHERE
        od.ordered_at BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-08-01'
        AND od.status <> 'cancelled'
        AND od.deleted_at IS NULL
    GROUP BY
        p.category
),
net_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        (revenue_cents - COALESCE(SUM(refund_cents), 0)) AS revenue_cents
    FROM
        revenue_data
    GROUP BY
        category
)
SELECT
    category,
    SUM(revenue_cents) AS revenue_cents
FROM
    net_revenue
GROUP BY
    category
ORDER BY
    revenue_cents DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH region_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        r.name AS region,
        SUM(ol.amount_cents - COALESCE(rf.amount_cents, 0)) AS services_revenue_cents
    FROM
        orders od
    JOIN
        customers c ON od.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN
        regions r ON c.region_id = r.region_id
    JOIN
        order_lines ol ON od.order_id = ol.order_id
    LEFT JOIN
        refunds rf ON od.order_id = rf.order_id
    JOIN
        products p ON ol.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE
        p.category ='services'
        AND od.status <> 'cancelled'
        AND od.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND od.ordered_at BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-08-01'
    GROUP BY
        r.name
)
SELECT
    region,
    SUM(services_revenue_cents) AS services_revenue_cents
FROM
    region_revenue
GROUP BY
    region

        o.status,
        o.deleted_at
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_lines ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
        AND o.deleted_at IS NULL

),
refunds_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        r.order_id,
        SUM(r.amount_cents) AS refund_cents
    FROM refunds r
    JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.ordered_at BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY r.order_id
),
net_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.ordered_at,
        ol.amount_cents - COALESCE(rf.refund_cents, 0) AS net_revenue_cents
    FROM orders_filtered o
    JOIN order_lines ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    LEFT JOIN refunds_filtered rf ON o.order_id = rf.order_id
),
fiscal_quarters AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN o.ordered_at BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-07-31' THEN 'FQ2'
            WHEN o.ordered_at BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' THEN 'FQ3'
        END AS fiscal_quarter,
        SUM(nr.net_revenue_cents) AS revenue_cents
    FROM net_revenue nr
    JOIN orders_filtered o ON nr.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY fiscal_quarter
)
SELECT * FROM fiscal_quarters

)

    r.name AS region,
    SUM(tu.units) AS units
